summary: The clerk in {place} finds the county beside the date of the proclamation that put it under drought emergency powers.
realLife: California's September 2024 termination listed nineteen counties under three earlier proclamation dates and ended related provisions in the listed jurisdictions.
gates: The termination schedule and the county's original proclamation can be cross-referenced.
inGame: needs: the termination schedule and the county's original proclamation can be cross-referenced.

turns.pulledBy: The county appears on the signed termination schedule.
turns.what: Give the county the applicable end date.

turns.pulledBy: The county is absent from the schedule.
turns.what: Look up the county's own current order.
turns.writesBack: Keep its status separate from the listed counties.
